title: Atlas provider profile
description: What Atlas knows about one provider type. Validated after a user file is merged over the shipped file of the same id.

id.description: Equals the file name without .toml; lower case.

evidence.description: How the facts were checked: against a running endpoint, the vendor's documentation only, or not at all.

dialect.description: Wire format: OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses or Anthropic Messages.

implicit.description: Selectable without ATLAS_PROVIDERS, under the variables in [env]. Shipped files only.

disabled.description: Hides the profile from menus and refuses instances bound to it.

base_url.description: Default base URL; empty when the operator must supply one.

models_paging.description: How the model list pages: none, or after_id (limit, after_id, has_more and last_id, as Anthropic's list pages).

header.description: Header that carries the key (default Authorization).

prefix.description: Text before the key (default 'Bearer ' on Authorization, none on another header).

env.description: Variable names of an implicit instance. Shipped files only.

headers.description: Static headers sent on every request to this provider. Never the key.

models.description: Rules for the model ids a glob matches (fnmatch, case-sensitive): request and reasoning settings that differ for them.

temperature.description: False where the vendor refuses a sampling temperature.

tool_choice_rejected.description: tool_choice values the vendor refuses; auto is sent instead.

max_tools.description: How many tool schemas one request may carry. Above Atlas's common 128, bounded by the window (one schema per 2,000 tokens); when it holds every tool, an analysis run lists them all from the first turn and the list never changes.

rate_limit_counts_cache_reads.description: False where the vendor's input-tokens-per-minute limit does not count tokens read from its prompt cache: Atlas's own pacing then leaves them out too.

control.description: How a thinking level is spelled on the wire.

levels.description: The levels the vendor takes, each mapped to its value on the wire.

echo_fields.description: Reply fields the vendor wants back in the history on later turns.
